steps.do: Solder the parts of JL, JR, P and the three adapters. Every lead on the rear faces of JL, JR, P and the adapters is cut to 1 mm or less when the part is soldered (DS-88).
steps.where: P 49, JL 19, JR 11, O3 1, listed below

steps.do: Solder the panel hardware with the panel as the fixture, and fit the P unit with EL on its six rigid pairs (DS-43).
Fit the brass posts on the front boards from the panel side: JL 6, JR 6, P 6 (DS-43).

Before the panel goes on, push an M3 × 25 mm screw (head at most 5.5 mm, not countersunk) through each sleeve hole from the front of its board and hold the head down with a strip of tape: (74, 28) on JL, (244, 24) on JR, (93, 276) on P, (244, 230) on P through the 7 mm access hole of EL (DS-76).
Slip a printed sleeve over each screw: long (18.8 mm) on JL and JR, short (16.8 mm) on P.
Put JL, JR and the P unit in the panel, and the three adapters on their selectors.

Plug the front end of every cable into its front connector and close the lock by hand only at the center of the actuator. Do not insert tools or fingernails into the connector. Every front end is plugged and locked before K comes down.
Fold each cable upward under its slot so that its free end stands up from the board.

Lower K over the 18 posts in 9 stages, highest end first, guiding the cable ends through their slots stage by stage (largest stage: 17 ends at 23.63 mm), then the four screw ends through K at 6.4 and 4.4 mm.
Fasten K's screw at every post first.
Put a nut on each of the four sleeve screws and turn it with the fingers until it is snug. No tool and no thread lock. A washer only where the screw end still comes through the nut with it.

Fold each cable end onto K's rear face, insert it into its K connector and close the lock by hand only at the center of the actuator; never press K with the palm (DS-66). Do not insert tools or fingernails into the connector. At the 12 connectors named below, the other hand holds K's edge beside the connector while its lock is closed (DS-87).
Before power: look at every one of the 124 locks, closed and square, and check the continuity of every link (DS-43).
